references.text: Describes living, raw flesh in a wound as a sign of uncleanness, the same theme as in verse 14.
Continues the theme of living flesh and uncleanness, describing the priest's assessment of the condition.
Refers to living flesh in connection with burns and uncleanness.
Summarizes the laws concerning skin diseases and what makes a person unclean or clean.
Deals with uncleanness related to contact with dead bodies, a related concept of ritual impurity.
